description: What-if sandbox: give an event (hormuz_closure, bab_el_mandeb_attack, suez_disruption, sanctions, opec_cut, ceasefire, eu_energy_shock, custom) with duration and severity; get real current baseline (risk, Brent, diesel, BTC, ETH, EUR/USD) plus a transparent rule-table estimate of risk change and direction/strength for Brent, diesel, BTC, EUR and qualitative Germany/EU consequences. GeoQuant model estimate, not a forecast. Call this when you want to stress-test a geo/energy event.
